submitted.rationale: Of the 3 EQE measurements, #31 (Ca0.14 Cu0.18 V0.68) was highest at 0.161%. #49 (V0.60) measured 0.102% and #87 (Cu-rich, V0.34) measured 0.062%. EQE rose as the films became more V-rich and Ca-poor. XRD showed that the Cu-rich films (#87, #114, #116) share one phase assemblage. #49 has extra peaks, which points to a V-rich phase mixture linked to higher activity.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.062%, lowest of the three. Its XRD phase matches the Cu-rich region.
Their XRD phase matches #87, which had low EQE, and EQE fell as Cu increased.
